new_independent_input.reason_for_admission_after_z24: The covariant Einstein-aether/khronometric route is an independently developed action-level preferred-foliation framework predating the present soft-s obstruction. It is admitted only to test whether its covariant/hypersurface-orthogonal structure itself supplies the missing projectable HMT local-U(1) physical-matter interface map.

frozen_question: Does the independently motivated covariant Einstein-aether -> hypersurface-orthogonal/IR-Horava bridge explicitly determine the projectable HMT local-U(1) auxiliary-field matter interface, including a unique a1,a2-equivalent relation, without fitting RTK response?
decision_rule: Return MATCH_MAP_FOUND only if the audited pre-soft-s Einstein-aether/khronometric sources explicitly supply every HMT matching requirement. If the covariant preferred-frame and hypersurface-orthogonal IR-Horava bridge are source-locked but one or more HMT-specific requirements are absent, return NO_HMT_U1_MATCH_MAP. If the source metadata cannot establish the bridge claims, fail closed as SOURCE_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE.

selecting a1 or a2 from RTK pole/residue/remainder
using the failed soft-s observable to choose a matter frame
